notes.title: Fix to PID controlled AI Units
notes.content: After a long struggle, I managed to configure PID controller for AI units to enable them to navigate the large map smoothly, in this update, I added an RC-135 Advanced Recon aircraft that flys a terminal course, you can spawn the F-16 in Operation FireFly and fly toward the main city airport "Towards the Sun to the north" sorry about the vague instructions, just till I add UI to NAV, you just gonna have to do it all VFR and VID........
